ai.suggestedSummary: DPA completed. The customer called the company and arrears were discussed. A job change moved payday from the twenty-fifth to the last Friday of the month, creating a gap before wages arrived. The customer agreed to pay £120 through the portal on 30 October. The customer plans to reset the portal password, and the company will call on 2 November, preferably after 5.30 pm, to discuss the remaining arrears; the customer was asked to contact the company if wages are delayed.
